name: handoff-gpt6sol
prompt: Hand this request to the Echoer: echo the message 'handoff-probe' and tell me what came back.
steer: You MUST hand the request off to the Echoer agent with its transfer tool. Do not call the echo tool yourself and do not answer yourself.

openaiHandoff.name: Echoer
openaiHandoff.instructions: You echo messages. Call the echo tool with the exact message you are given, then reply with the tool's result and nothing else.
openaiHandoff.handoffDescription: Echoes a message with the echo tool.
